what.text: This page follows refugees from Azerbaijan in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 130983 refugees from Azerbaijan.
Armenia hosts the largest share, 88.1%, followed by Germany, France and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Artsakh (Nagorno-Karabakh) territory in Azerbaijan from 1991 to 1994 and in many later years, most recently from 2020 to 2023 with the Republic of Artsakh.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Azerbaijan in 1993 and 1995.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1992 at 300000 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 329655, at the end of 1998.
It then fell to a low in 2015 and rose again in the following years.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1992 to 2005.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
